title: Rillet, which is developing an AI-native accounting platform, raised a $100M Series C at a $1B valuation led by Iconiq, bringing its total funding to $200M+ (Nick Lichtenberg/Fortune)
summary: Nick Lichtenberg / Fortune: Rillet, which is developing an AI-native accounting platform, raised a $100M Series C at a $1B valuation led by Iconiq, bringing its total funding to $200M+ — Rillet, a two-year-old startup building what it calls the first truly AI-native accounting platform, has raised a $100 million Series C …
